author: Raziv
review_text: This app is good for almost all payment systems in one place. The problem I’m facing is that I recently disconnected my linked accounts, but not the withdrawal account. Both accounts are from the same bank. Now, I can't link my account again, even though the account number and other credentials are correct. The same bank is already connected in the withdrawal section, but it’s not connecting in the linked area. The main issue is that the verification window doesn’t verify.
